items.title: Collect a box of Sugar Bombs
items.detail: Check Santatron/Fasnacht Collectron at C.A.M.P., or fast travel to New River Gorge Bridge - West

items.title: Collect Toilet Paper
items.detail: Whitespring Robo Butler Collectron or red brick maintenance building behind Whitespring Resort

items.title: Collect a Plunger
items.detail: Red brick maintenance building north of Whitespring Resort, or Wavy Willard's Water Park restrooms

items.title: Complete a Daily Quest
items.detail: Cop a Squatter Daily at Watoga Emergency Services is quick

items.title: Cripple a Protectron or a Robobrain's Arm
items.detail: RobCo Research Center has Protectrons; use V.A.T.S. for easier limb targeting

items.title: Kill a Creature
items.detail: Whitespring Golf Club has dense Feral Ghouls

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during an Infestation while on a Team
items.detail: Join any team; find Infestation marked on map and kill Phantoms inside

items.title: Build a Decoration in a Shelter
items.detail: Enter your Shelter, access build menu, place any decoration like a balloon

items.title: Catch a Fish
items.detail: Fish at any water source; Fisherman's Rest in The Mire is ideal

items.title: Collect RadAway or Rad-X
items.detail: Collect from world loot or craft diluted forms at chemistry station with Purified Water

items.title: Collect Soap
items.detail: Whitespring Robo Butler Collectron or behind main Whitespring Resort building

items.title: Collect a Board Game
items.detail: Use Games Cupboard at C.A.M.P. to take board games directly

items.title: Eat a Vegetable
items.detail: Harvest and eat raw vegetables like Tato or Corn from C.A.M.P. or Billings Homestead

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during a Daily Operation!
items.detail: Enter Daily Ops from World Activity; Phantoms are the masked cultists from Slasher event

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during an Infestation
items.detail: Find gray Infestation area on Pip-Boy map, locate red hotspot and kill Phantoms

items.title: Complete a Gold Star Daily Challenge!
items.detail: Complete all six other dailies on three separate days during the week

events.name: Mutated Public Events
events.description: Public events spawn with mutations, awarding Mutated Party Packages with exclusive rewards.

events.name: Double SCORE Weekend and Murmrgh's Special Pick
events.description: Earn double SCORE points while Murmrgh offers special legendary weapon modules for sale.

events.name: Slasher C.A.M.P. Contest
events.description: Community competition to build the best C.A.M.P. designs related to the Slasher seasonal event.

events.name: Mischief Night
events.description: Seasonal Halloween-themed event featuring prankster gameplay and exclusive cosmetic rewards.

events.name: Double Mutations
events.description: Daily Ops feature double mutation encounters with new and seasonal reward options.

events.name: Spooky Scorched
events.description: Face mutated scorched enemies in seasonal encounters with new exclusive rewards.

events.name: Double XP
events.description: Earn double experience points on all activities to level up faster.

events.name: Seasonal Fish Run Weekend
events.description: Increased chance to catch seasonal fish with new local legend and recipes available.
